name: Muconic acid
description: Muconic acid (CAS 505-70-4 ) is a dicarboxylic acid produced through both synthetic and bio-based fermentation routes, positioning it as a platform chemical at the intersection of green chemistry and industrial manufacturing. It functions as a precursor in the synthesis of high-value polymers, pharmaceuticals, and specialty chemicals, with growing commercial interest driven by its bio-renewable production pathways. Its primary industrial role is as a chemical intermediate for producing adipic acid and terephthalic acid, which are key monomers in nylon and PET production, making it a target material for bio-based polymer supply chains. In pharmaceutical synthesis, this compound serves as a building block for active ingredient intermediates requiring controlled dicarboxylic acid functionality and high chemical stability during the reaction process. Agricultural formulation developers evaluate it for pH buffering in liquid crop protection products where acid stability across dilution is a critical formulation requirement for effective field application. Biotechnology researchers also source it as a reference standard or fermentation process benchmark when developing microbial production platforms for sustainable chemical manufacturing and green engineering. The product is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. It is available in research-grade and technical-grade specifications, with purity levels typically ranging from 97% to 99%+ depending on intended use. Packaging options range from small laboratory quantities to bulk orders supporting pilot-scale and commercial production.
